column5: action
Write down three things that went well today, and why.
Send someone a short message of genuine thanks for something specific.
Eat one meal or snack today with no screen, paying attention to it.
Listen to a favorite song all the way through, doing nothing else.
Stop for two minutes and actually look at the sky.

column1: # — Social connection (Sandstrom & Dunn weak ties; prosocial spending, Dunn) —

column5: Text someone you haven't spoken to in over a month, just to say hi.
Give one person a genuine, specific compliment today.
Do one small unrequested favor for someone.
Spend a few dollars on someone other than yourself today.
Have a brief friendly exchange with a stranger or acquaintance.
Take a 10-minute walk outside, no destination required.
Spend 15 minutes somewhere green or near water.
Take the stairs every time today.
Stretch for five unhurried minutes.

column1: # — Mind & order (Pennebaker expressive writing; implementation intentions; clutter/affect) —

column5: Write down the thing you're worried about, and one small next step.
Set a 10-minute timer and tidy one small area. Stop when it rings.
Sit quietly and follow your breath for three minutes.

column4: A LETTER TO YOUR FUTURE SELF
column5: Write two sentences to yourself one year from now.

column1: # — Anticipation & rest (Van Boven anticipation; sleep hygiene) —

column5: Put one thing you'll look forward to on the calendar.
No screens for the 30 minutes before bed tonight.
Get sunlight and a glass of water within an hour of waking.
Spend 10 minutes learning about something you're curious about, on purpose.
Try one small thing today you're slightly bad at.
Recall one good moment from yesterday in as much detail as you can.
Name three ordinary things you own that make life easier, and notice them.
Look through old photos for five minutes and send one to someone in it.
In your next conversation, ask one follow-up question instead of changing topic.
React or reply to a friend's post or message you'd normally just read.
Propose a concrete plan to see a friend — date, time, place.
Walk somewhere today you usually ride or drive.
Carry something heavy with good form — groceries count.
Step outside within 15 minutes of starting your day, even for one minute.
Write down everything on your mind for five minutes. Don't organize it.
Unsubscribe from three emails or mute three accounts that add nothing.
Say no to one small thing today, politely and without explanation.
Write one sentence: what would make today feel like a win?
Set tomorrow's clothes or bag out tonight.
Go to bed 30 minutes earlier than usual tonight.
Make a hot drink and do nothing else while you drink it.
Learn how to say one new phrase in another language.
Take a different route than usual for any trip today.
Teach someone one thing you know, in under five minutes.
Read 10 pages of any book.
